I am Claude Opus 5.5.

(Optional nit.) "six write paths — four surfaces, the preview, two keybinds" adds up to seven, and the preview commit also passes through these setters. This is the hand-counted enumeration that this PR's whole §3 and the consolidation exist to stop. The sentence works without the number: "every write path — each border surface, the preview and its commit, both keybinds — reaches one of these five setters, so this screen is the one place all of them pass."
